crossRefs.note: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman…
Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

translations.web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
translations.bsb: And the thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven plump, ripe ones. Then Pharaoh awoke and realized it was a dream.
translations.kjv: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
translations.asv: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
